# Decision memo: where Spotify's next quarter of product effort should go

*Generated by the memo role from saved aggregates only (gpt-6-luna|effort=none|memo-v4|mschema-v4). Every number is a code-computed value; its ID points to `claims.csv` (C) or the quantities table below (X).*

## Recommendation

Prioritize playback, because its top specific issue, `playback.general`, is ranked first in the business ranking and has priority score 117894 (C6). This follows the issue-level decision rule, even though usability has the largest area-level severity sum 179800 (X5).

## Supporting evidence

`playback.general` covers music stopping or restarting, playback failures, and false offline reports; its mean severity is 3.336843 (C5), a secondary consideration. A customer reports that music keeps stopping (review `98333d3d-0049-4711-a8c9-8daf98e04479`). In the baseline, `other.general` ranks first with priority score 178774 (C3), but it is a broad catch-all and is excluded from the business ranking; it has complaint count 90127 (C1) and mean severity 1.983579 (C2). The next business-ranked specific issue is `billing.paywall_named_feature`, with priority score 68708 (C9); a customer describes losing access to repeat controls (review `98fee45a-083f-4315-a7f5-3a66f9bd22fd`).

## Alternatives considered

Usability was not selected despite having the largest area-level severity sum 179800 (X5); its leading listed issue, `usability.ads`, ranks behind `playback.general` in the business ranking and has priority score 64246 (C12). Billing/support ranks below playback by area severity sum 149052 (X11), and its leading listed issue, `billing.paywall_named_feature`, also ranks behind `playback.general` with priority score 68708 (C9). Access has the smallest area-level severity sum among the four areas 38464 (X2); its first listed issue, `access.login`, ranks below the issues cited above in the business ranking. The recommendation therefore follows the specified issue-level rule rather than selecting the largest area total.

## Sensitivity check: paywall severity

If named-feature paywall complaints were severity two instead of three, the top issue would remain `other.general`; the sensitivity check gives it priority score 178766 (X24), compared with 117834 (X25) for `playback.general} and 46289 (X26) for `billing.paywall_named_feature`. Thus the sensitivity result does not change the top specific issue after excluding the catch-all, and playback remains the recommendation under the issue-level rule.

## Limitations

The evidence consists of self-selected, public, historical Google Play reviews from an eighteen-month window ending in November, not a representative sample of Spotify users. There is no revenue, plan-tier, or confirmed churn data; stated cancellation intent is not observed churn. Model labels have imperfect agreement with human labels and an independent verifier, and fixed feature-word rules may leave distinct problems hidden within broad groups. Rankings exclude quarantined reviews 83 (X21) and any unclassified reviews; the reported pending unclassified count is 0 (X22).
